title: MLIPS: Multi-Layer Indexer Pool Sharing
abstract: arXiv:2610.27438v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sparse attention limits the keys used by each query, but finding those keys can still require a full-prefix scan at every layer. We introduce \textbf{MLIPS (Multi-Layer Indexer Pool Sharing)}, a training-free method that shares candidate search while retaining each consumer's own scoring and selection. A producer publishes a top-$M$ pool larger than the attention budget $K$; subsequent layers select their own top-$K$ from that pool. Measurements across three sparse-attention model families show substantially higher coverage from broad pools than overlap between final selections. We implement layerwise sharing, persistent decode reuse, and a coarse producer in vLLM for DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Across four long-context suites, three consumer layers per producer give $1.14$--$1.40\times$ speedups and $14.8$--$27.4\%$ lower GPU energy, with observed accuracy changes of $-1.49$ to $+0.29$ percentage points in single runs. translated_abstract: 稀疏注意力限制了每个查询所使用的键的数量，但寻找这些键仍可能需要在每一层对完整前缀进行扫描。我们提出了MLIPS（多层索引器池共享），这是一种无需训练的方法，它在共享候选搜索的同时，保留每个使用方自己的打分与选择。生产者会发布一个大于注意力预算K的top-M候选池；后续各层从该池中选出自己的top-K。在三个稀疏注意力模型家族上的测量表明，宽泛候选池所提供的覆盖率显著高于最终选择之间的重叠程度。我们在vLLM中为DeepSeek-V4-Flash实现了逐层共享、持久解码复用以及粗粒度生产者。在四个长上下文测试套件上，每个生产者对应三个使用层的设置可带来1.14–1.40倍的加速和14.8–27.4%的GPU能耗降低，单次运行中观察到的准确率变化为−1.49至+0.29个百分点。更广泛的共享能够…
tldr: MLIPS是一种无需训练的方法，通过让一个生产者层发布超出预算的top-M候选池供后续多个层共享复用，在保留各层独立打分与选择的同时消除重复的候选搜索，在DeepSeek-V4-Flash上实现了1.14–1.40倍加速和14.8–27.4%的GPU能耗降低，且准确率几乎不受影响。
en_tdlr: MLIPS is a training-free method in which a producer layer publishes an oversized top-M candidate pool shared by multiple subsequent layers, eliminating redundant candidate search while preserving each layer's own scoring and selection, achieving 1.14–1.40× speedups and 14.8–27.4% lower GPU energy on DeepSeek-V4-Flash with negligible accuracy impact.
